note.summary: Section 75 makes a court-appointed receiver assessable and chargeable to income tax on property under the court's control as if it were not under that control, and answerable for all assessment/payment obligations. Section 76 is repealed. Section 77 extends Part VII (except s.76) to capital gains tax without affecting who is chargeable to CGT for exemption/rate purposes. New Part 7A (ss.77B-77F) creates a secondary-liability regime allowing HMRC to serve notices on Petroleum Act 1998 licence-holders for unpaid tax assessed on non-UK residents relating to their licences, subject to pre-conditions, exceptions for pre-1974 contracts, and exemption certificates.

note.summary: Section 31A sets the 30-day time limit and formal requirements for giving notice of appeal under section 31, specifying the relevant trigger date and officer depending on the type of decision appealed. Section 31AA gives taxpayers a right to query a simple assessment within 60 days, sets out HMRC's duties to consider and respond to the query, and allows postponement of payment while queried. Sections 31B-31D are repealed/empty. Section 32 allows relief against double assessment via claim to the Board, with a 30-day appeal right against refusal. Section 33 introduces Schedule 1AB governing claims for recovery of overpaid income tax and CGT.
